notes.title: Update 1.0.7: Gameplay Modifier
notes.notes:
[h3]Good news everyone! [/h3]

We are back with another exciting content update for Knight vs Giant: The Broken Excalibur! In this update, we have implemented [b]gameplay modifiers[/b] that allow you to deeply customize the level of challenge you'll experience during runs. 

This new feature will [b]unlock after you have recruited the Jester[/b] to your kingdom and will trigger either when you head into a dungeon, or when you talk to the Jester in the kingdom. The modifier settings will remain unchanged unless altered, meaning they will not reset once you return from your run.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38537648/f7e14ca91aa9cbf6e3740883c788d479ddba6a19.gif[/img]

Each active modifier will progress the bar by 1 node, with [b]bonus coins and giant crystals available[/b] for every 5 nodes (+125%, +150%, +200%). The more challenging your runs, the higher the amount of coins and crystals that will drop once an area has been cleared.

[b]We have listed all gameplay modifiers and their values below:[/b]
[list]
[*] Enemy HP (100%, 150%, 200%) - increases the HP of enemies
[*] Enemy Damage (100%, 150%, 200%) - increases the damage dealt by enemies
[*] Enemy Count (100%, 150%, 200%) - increases the amount of enemies spawned (not including mini-bosses and giants)
[*] Additional Elite Enemies (Normal, +1, +2) - increases the amount of Elite Enemies in the first wave of each room
[*] Arthur Max HP (100%, 75%, 50%) - reduces Arthur's max HP
[*] Disable Active Skill Slots (none, 1 slot, 2 slots) - reduces the amount of Active Skill Slots
[*] Merchant item Prices (100%, 150%, 200%) - increases the price of items sold by the traveling merchant
[*] Disable Runes Drop - no runes will be dropped[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38537648/b8e249ed91ec24627648e1f63af3cf884f6ae6ed.png[/img]
[i]In addition to this new content we have also made some additional improvements and bug fixes. You can check out the full patch notes below:[/i]

[b]1.0.7 Patch Notes[/b]

[b]Improvements & bug fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed Bors' secondary skill (Slicing Orbit) knives always dealing critical damage for each of knife
[*] Fixed roll/dodge length becoming shorter after attacking or getting damaged
[*] Increased the spawn chance and amount of potions
[*] Tristan's secondary skill (Thousand Blossom Slash) now always hits 3 times even if there's only 1 enemy left
[/list]
As always, thank you for all your continued support and we hope you'll enjoy playing with the new customization options! 

Gambir Studio & PQube

notes.title: Update 1.0.5: The Power of the Runes
notes.notes:
[h3]Welcome back, knights![/h3]

We hope you have enjoyed playing [b]Knight vs Giant: The Broken Excalibur[/b] so far. Have you slain its many giants yet, or did you get slain? Whichever way your quest went, we come bearing some good news!

Today, we're releasing [b]the new content update 1.0.5 that adds another feature to help you triumph in your adventures: Runes![/b]

[u][b]Runic powers[/b][/u]

Runes come in the form of small stones that drop after you slay powerful enemies, such as mini bosses and giants. You may also come across them while clearing a crystal room, or when taking down the elite enemies added in the previous patch. 

Should you choose to pick up a rune, they will bestow an upgrade upon Arthur's stats, such as his HP or movement speed, granting you better chances of surviving your battles against fearsome foes!

[u][b]Make your choice[/b][/u]

Sometimes, runes will drop in a group of two, or even three. It's up to you to choose the rune that fits your battle plans best. Should you go for more critical damage, or perhaps go for strengthening your sword attack? It's up to you to make the most out of the runes at hand. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38537648/21f8a6a22d9fdebeef106220ec28a84b2c3987bd.png[/img]

[i]See below for the full list of features and fixes coming with the new update:[/i]

[u][b]Update 1.0.5[/b][/u]

[b]New Feature:[/b][list]
[*] Implemented the new Runes mechanic
[*] Runes are collectible items that will occasionally drop after the player defeats certain enemies or clears certain rooms
[*] Runes have various effects that will temporarily increase Arthur's stats while inside the dungeon
[/list]
[b]Improvements & Balancing:[/b][list]
[*] Improved minion AI behaviour
[*] Displayed minion stagger bar below their health bar (minions can now be staggered after filling their stagger bars with attacks and certain skills)
[*] Minor performance improvement
[*] Added more elite enemy attack patterns
[/list]

We hope the rune system will make your journey into the Astral Dimension even more satisfying and exciting, as you can further equip Arthur with the tools you need to emerge victorious. Give it a try and we'll see you soon with more updates.

As always, [b]if you do have any comments or issues please let us know via the Steam forums[/b] or alternatively [b]join our [url=https://discord.gg/acdAUdfZp5]Discord[/url] [/b]where we’ll be happy to chat! 

Fare thee well!

Gambir Studio & PQube

notes.title: Update 1.0.4: Morgana's Blessings and Curses & Elite Enemies
notes.notes:
[h3]Welcome back, knights![/h3]

It’s been almost a month since the release of [b]Knight vs Giant: The Broken Excalibur[/b] and we hope you’ve been enjoying your adventures with King Arthur, Merlin, and the Knights of the Round Table in our legendary action roguelite! 

Over the past few weeks, we’ve been working hard on improving the game and we’d like to thank you all for your feedback and support so far, it really means a lot!

We did however notice a lot of your comments relating to [b]Morgana and her associated blessings and curses[/b], so today, we’re excited to be releasing [b]the new content update 1.0.4 that reworks how these mechanics function in-game alongside the introduction of elite enemies, and a number of balancing improvements and bug fixes![/b]

[u][b]A matter of balance[/b][/u]

Originally Morgana’s blessings and curses were designed to be completely randomised and unrelated to one another, but with this new update they will always be[b] generated in pairs to ensure a more balanced trade-off between the good and the bad[/b]. In addition, when encountering Morgana during a run, Arthur will be given [b]a preview of the blessing and curse combination before making his choice. 
[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38537648/cae8b089637e0ce018e0d7a867c057ec295377d7.png[/img]

[u][b]New perils await[/b][/u]

The new blessing and curse combinations will also [b]change gameplay more dramatically, offsetting greater benefits with higher but more appropriately calculated risks[/b]. Some examples of the new curses offered to you by Morgana include “Parched” which will result in health fountains drying out, and “Drunk” which causes Arthur to dash in reverse! But fear not! Enjoy discovering numerous new blessings including buffs to dash distance, skill damage, killing minions with one hit, and much more!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38537648/4ae70d9db9343d80bf2dc9b8d7832da3be86f25c.gif[/img]

[b][u]The bigger the better [/u][/b]

As you get stronger, so will your enemies! Get ready for the elite minions! These variations of the common minion are equipped with two HP bars and cannot be staggered or knocked away by your attacks before the first bar has been broken. Beware, some of the elite are equipped with vicious attack variations compared to their regular counterparts, so you better start training!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38537648/c649b796d2f47819aa26a139b00868d6ef7f96e5.png[/img]

[i]See below for the full list of features and fixes coming with the new update:[/i]

[u][b]Update 1.0.4[/b][/u]

[b]New content:[/b]
[list]
[*] Revamped Morgana's curse and blessing system. 20 new curse and blessing pairings have been added
[*] Curses/blessings now come in pairs, offering different playstyles and greater risk-and-reward
[*] Players can now see the curse/blessing effects before deciding to accept Morgana's offer
[*] Elite enemies will now appear as players progress through the game. These enemies are bigger, have more health, and have more dangerous attack patterns
[*] Giants now have new additional attacks
[/list]
[b]Improvement & Balancing:[/b]
[list]
[*] Percival's sword's last hit in a combo now inflicts the "weak" status effect
[*] Increased Percival's sword damage (30 to 45)
[*] Increased Tristan's sword damage (30 to 35)
[*] Improved the AI behaviour of giants
[*] Increased Bedivere's "Furious Intent" attack speed (from 2% to 7% for other swords, 10% for Bedivere's sword)
[*] Increased Bedivere's "Obtuse Cleave" radius (from 10% to 20% for other swords, 50% for Bedivere's sword)
[*] Increased Lancelot's "Death Blow" health threshold for increased damage to enemies with low HP (from 10% to 25% enemy HP remaining)
[*] Increased Percival's "Pinpoint Attack" critical chance (from 2.5% to 5% for other swords, 4% to 7% for Percival's sword)
[*] Increased Tristan's "Artisanal Swordplay" attack speed (from 5% to 10% for other swords, 7% to 10% for Tristan's Sword)
[*] Increased Tristan's "Windswept Step" value (from 3% to 4% for other swords, 5% to 7% for Tristan's sword)
[*] Increased Percival's critical damage multiplier (from 120% to 140%)
[*] Increased Percival's critical chance (from 1% to 5%)
[*] Increased Percival's base sword damage (from 35 to 45)
[*] Increased Bedivere's critical chance (from 1% to 5%)
[*] Players must now hold the interact button to use fountains (community request)
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that occured when the player disconnected the controller during input binding
[*] Fixed a bug where the player could not control Arthur for several miliseconds after executing Percival's sword skill
[*] Fixed the Violet flower buff giving 10 bonus Soul Orbs instead of the stated range
[*] Fixed the cooldown duration of sword skills inaccurately displayed
[*] Fixed the effect calculations for the following blessings and items: "Rupturing Cut", "Stinger's Chase", "Nimble Streak", "Ki Breathing", "Wolf's Dexterity", "Devastating Rush", "Furious Intent",  "Artisanal Swordplay", and "Heartpiercer"
[*] Fixed the effect calculations for the following items: "Wind Pendant" and "Blood Clover"
[*] Fixed the descriptions for the following blessings: "Lethal Toxic", "Volcanic Surge", "Afterburn"
[/list]
We hope you’ll have fun trying out these new blessings and curses, and battling elite enemies during your next run, and we’ll be back with more updates soon. 

In the meantime,[b] if you do have any comments or issues please let us know via the Steam forums[/b] or alternatively and [b]join our [url=https://discord.gg/acdAUdfZp5]Discord[/url] [/b]where we’ll be happy to chat! 

Fare thee well!

Gambir Studio & PQube
